# Grand Bend Heating & Cooling

> Heating and cooling requests for Grand Bend. Ductless air-conditioning installation covers single-zone and multi-zone mini-split equipment for spaces without suitable ductwork.

Email: contact@grandbendheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://grandbendheatingcooling.ca

Request locations: Grand Bend, Port Franks, Thedford, Parkhill, Forest. Coverage and availability require provider confirmation.
